title: Example player chrome is missing until POST /jobs succeeds

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Live aurit.us/examples/basic: after boot, Play exists in shadow DOM (Ready, ~23s audio). First paint has no chrome because boot awaits POST /jobs before mountPlayer. Empty .auritus-player-host looks like sage page background. Accessibility snapshot also omits the shadow Play button.

Fix: first-paint placeholder plus mount chrome before createJob; 404 while creating is waiting, not failure.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Live https://aurit.us/examples/basic and /examples/qwen show Play after boot and generated audio (Kokoro ~23s, Qwen ~48s). First paint still says Loading player, and Play at the end of a clip does not restart. Remaining chrome work is auritus-ab3214.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Superseded by auritus-ab3214. Live aurit.us now SSRs Play chrome and mounts the player before POST /jobs. Closing with that proof.

right_now_summary: The player now shows its Play controls on first paint and mounts before job creation.
